name: DNS Resolution Failure
checks: Confirm the client has the expected DNS server addresses.
Test resolution of the reported hostname using dns_lookup.
If resolution fails, test reachability to the configured DNS server.
Only then inspect DNS records, forwarders, conditional forwarders or filtering.
stop_condition: Stop when the failure is isolated to client DNS configuration, DNS server reachability, or record/forwarding resolution.
resolution: Correct only the isolated DNS configuration, reachability, or record issue.
